name: beanfmt
description: Fast beancount file formatter with CJK support

beanfmt.indent.description: Number of spaces for indentation. Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

beanfmt.currencyColumn.description: Column to align currencies to. Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

beanfmt.costColumn.description: Column to align costs/prices to. Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

beanfmt.inlineCommentColumn.description: Column to align inline comments (;) to. 0 disables alignment (comment stays one space after content). Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

beanfmt.thousandsSeparator.description: Thousands separator handling: keep as-is, add commas, or remove them. Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

beanfmt.spacesInBraces.description: Add spaces inside cost braces, e.g. { 100 USD } instead of {100 USD}. Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

beanfmt.fixedCJKWidth.description: Treat CJK (East Asian) characters as double-width for alignment. Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

beanfmt.sort.description: Sort entries by date: off (no sorting), asc (ascending), or desc (descending). Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

beanfmt.sortTimeless.description: Where to place entries without time metadata within a day: begin (before timed entries), end (after timed entries), or keep (preserve original order). Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

beanfmt.sortExclude.description: Directive types to exclude from sorting. Excluded directives act as sort barriers. Ignored when a .beanfmt.toml or beanfmt.toml exists in the workspace; the config file is the source of truth.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: bun run build:wasm && bun run compile
scripts.build:wasm: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir editors/code/wasm --features wasm --no-default-features
